Here are two sources that state the UN Charter was adopted/signed in 1945 — including an official United Nations source:

- United Nations — "UN Charter" (UN official page). ([un.org](https://www.un.org/en/about-us/un-charter?utm_source=openai))  
- U.S. National Archives — "United Nations Charter (1945)". ([archives.gov](https://www.archives.gov/milestone-documents/united-nations-charter?utm_source=openai))

(For reference, these sources note the Charter was signed at the San Francisco conference on 26 June 1945 and came into force on 24 October 1945.) ([un.org](https://www.un.org/en/about-us/un-charter?utm_source=openai))
